_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "collections" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'manual', "source_ref" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "games" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "collection_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES collections (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "order_idx" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "pgn" TEXT NOT NULL, "headers_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', "white" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "black" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "event" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "date" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "result" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '*', "eco" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "opening" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "root_fen" TEXT NULL, "ply_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "issues_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "repertoires" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "color" TEXT NOT NULL, "root_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "root_fen" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "options_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "rep_positions" ("repertoire_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES repertoires (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "position_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "fen" TEXT NOT NULL, "comment" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "shapes" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "conflict_deferred" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("conflict_deferred" IN (0, 1)), "engine_flag" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', PRIMARY KEY ("repertoire_id", "position_key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "rep_moves" ("repertoire_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES repertoires (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "from_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "uci" TEXT NOT NULL, "to_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "san" TEXT NOT NULL, "role" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "weight" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 50, "comment" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "source" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'manual', "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("repertoire_id", "from_key", "uci"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "cards" ("repertoire_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES repertoires (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "position_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "stability" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "difficulty" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "due" INTEGER NULL, "last_review" INTEGER NULL, "reps" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "lapses" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'newCard', "suspended" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("suspended" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("repertoire_id", "position_key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "review_logs" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "repertoire_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES repertoires (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "position_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "timestamp" INTEGER NOT NULL, "grade" TEXT NOT NULL, "played_uci" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "expected_uci" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "mode" TEXT NOT NULL, "response_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "scheduled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("scheduled" IN (0, 1)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "linked_accounts" ("provider" TEXT NOT NULL, "username" TEXT NOT NULL, "token_ref" TEXT NULL, "scopes" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "connected_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "last_sync_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("provider"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "imported_games" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "provider" TEXT NOT NULL, "external_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "pgn" TEXT NOT NULL, "played_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "user_color" TEXT NOT NULL, "time_control" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "speed" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "result" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '*', "opponent" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "url" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "rated" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("rated" IN (0, 1)), "analyzed_at" INTEGER NULL, UNIQUE ("provider", "external_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "gap_events" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "imported_game_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES imported_games (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "repertoire_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES repertoires (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "position_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "fen" TEXT NOT NULL, "ply" INTEGER NOT NULL, "played_san" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "played_uci" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "expected_san" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "dismissed" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("dismissed" IN (0, 1)));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "explorer_cache" ("cache_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "json" TEXT NOT NULL, "fetched_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("cache_key"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "http_cache" ("url" TEXT NOT NULL, "etag" TEXT NULL, "last_modified" TEXT NULL, "fetched_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("url"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "settings" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));
